tcpdump_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the tcpdump decoder.

timer_mode.description: Packet timing method: select, ioport, gtod, or nano.

preload_pcap.description: Preload packets into RAM before sending.

cachefile.description: Path to tcpprep cache file for splitting traffic.

intf1.description: Primary network interface for sending traffic.

intf2.description: Secondary network interface for bi-directional replay.

dualfile.description: Replay two files simultaneously from a network tap.

loop_count.description: Number of times to loop through the capture file.

loop_delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between loop iterations.

loop_delay_ns.description: Delay in nanoseconds between loop iterations.

packet_limit.description: Maximum number of packets to send. -1 sends all.

duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration in seconds. -1 sends for all time.

speed_multiplier.description: Replay speed multiplier (e.g., '2.0'). Mutually exclusive with pps/mbps/topspeed.

pps_rate.description: Packets per second rate. Mutually exclusive with multiplier/mbps/topspeed.

mbps_rate.description: Megabits per second rate. Mutually exclusive with multiplier/pps/topspeed.

oneatatime.description: Replay one packet at a time, waiting for user input.

pps_multi.description: Number of packets to send per interval for high pps rates.

unique_ip.description: Modify IPs each loop to generate unique flows.

unique_ip_loops.description: Number of loops before assigning new unique IP (requires unique_ip).

netmap.description: Enable netmap support for direct adapter access.

no_flow_stats.description: Suppress flow statistics collection and printing.

flow_expiry.description: Flow expiry time in seconds (0 for no expiry).

stats_interval.description: Print statistics every X seconds (0 for every loop).

xdp.description: Enable AF_XDP support for direct adapter access.

xdp_batch_size.description: Maximum packets submitted to AF_XDP TX ring at once.

pcap_files.description: List of PCAP files or directories to replay. Example: ['/var/log/traffic.pcap']
